scope: Every entity in the served target snapshot/view; data membership is verified, browser reachability and behavior are untested.
acceptance: Figma-like continuous pointer-anchored zoom across L1–L4; no discontinuous geometry/camera frame jump, unwanted oscillation, outgoing edge overlay, or minimap mismatch. L1–L2 requires a fresh full retest.

scenarioDefinitions.zoomIn: Continuous one-direction wheel zoom toward this node; cross its deeper boundary when children exist, otherwise verify stable leaf zoom without inventing descendants.
scenarioDefinitions.zoomOut: Continuous outward wheel zoom from this node through its available ancestor boundary; L1 verifies stable context zoom.
scenarioDefinitions.partialZoom: Stop below, within, and above each applicable semantic boundary; inspect all intermediate frames and settled state.
scenarioDefinitions.reversal: Reverse wheel direction mid-transition in both directions; distinguish intended reversal from unexplained motion using input timestamps.
scenarioDefinitions.restoredUrl: Restore the captured URL in a fresh tab, verify selection/root/lens/camera then repeat inward and outward input.
scenarioDefinitions.minimapIndicators: During all zoom phases and idle, compare minimap viewport and active-level indicators with the main canvas camera and semantic level.
scenarioDefinitions.minimapNavigation: Click and drag minimap viewport, then resume pointer-anchored zoom; verify correspondence and continuity.

statusRules.untested: No qualifying evidence on the final implementation.
statusRules.pass: Current implementation browser motion, input trace, and applicable indicators reviewed with evidence.
statusRules.fail: Observed behavior violates acceptance; evidence identifies timestamp and entity.
statusRules.blocked: Case attempted but cannot be completed; record specific reason.
statusRules.notApplicable: Only with a documented semantic reason; leaf status alone does not exempt zoom stability or minimap checks.
